output.reason: The changelog line [ev-0e368e6a6f71] and PR #10295 [ev-9d8e47910828] say only that SigV2 signing was removed from Loki's S3 request authentication, because AWS stopped accepting SigV2 requests. The PR touches pkg/storage/bucket/s3/config.go and the docs [ev-e5c8374b25dc], but neither the PR nor the changelog names the config key or its allowed values. Neither says what happens to a configuration that still selects v2: a startup or validation error, the setting being silently ignored, or a fallback to v4. The PR checklist says upgrade notes were written [ev-7844569c2c0b], but no upgrade-guide section is shown, so the consequence cannot be determined; the config-key diff or that upgrade-guide text is needed.
